summary: Mina meets Renfield, who tidies by eating flies and spiders, then speaks as a polished philosopher, urging her to leave and later blessing her. Van Helsing arrives and agrees that Mina must be removed from further danger. At nine o'clock the party forms a committee: Van Helsing lectures on the vampire's powers, weaknesses and the Dracula history from Arminius, and all pledge their hands over his golden crucifix. Morris fires at a bat on the windowsill, shattering the window pane. Plans: trace and sterilise the earth boxes and catch the Count between noon and sunset. Mina is excluded henceforth. As the men prepare to go to Carfax, Renfield begs frantically to be released that night, but Seward refuses.

scenes.title: Mina visits Renfield
scenes.summary: Renfield swallows his flies and spiders to 'tidy up', asks Mina to leave, then gives a lucid account of his old delusion about consuming life.
scenes.key_quote: For the blood is the life.

scenes.title: Van Helsing arrives
scenes.location: Station and carriage to the asylum
scenes.summary: Van Helsing learns the Count's house is next door and decides Mina must be kept out after tonight.
scenes.key_quote: Oh that we had known it before!

scenes.title: The committee and the pact
scenes.summary: Van Helsing lays his golden crucifix on the table; all clasp hands in a solemn compact. He lectures on the enemy, the vampire's limits and Dracula's history.
scenes.key_quote: There are such beings as vampires; some of us have evidence that they exist.

scenes.title: The bat and the pistol shot
scenes.summary: Morris sees a big bat on the window-sill and fires from outside, shattering the glass; it flies into the wood.
scenes.key_quote: a big bat came and sat on the window-sill.

scenes.title: Campaign planned; Mina excluded
scenes.summary: Plan: trace each box, capture or kill the Count, or sterilise the earth; he is weakest between noon and sunset. Mina is told to rest.
scenes.key_quote: we must, so to speak, sterilise the earth, so that no more he can seek safety in it.

scenes.title: Renfield begs to be released
scenes.summary: Renfield, courtly and lucid, introduces himself to each man and pleads to be freed immediately. Refused, he throws himself on his knees, then collapses into sullen silence.
scenes.key_quote: Don’t you know that I am sane and earnest now; that I am no lunatic in a mad fit, but a sane man fighting for his soul?

creatures.name: Count Dracula (described)
creatures.description: Strength of twenty men, ancient cunning, necromancy, no shadow or reflection, sees in the dark.
creatures.behaviour: Changes form to wolf, bat, mist, elemental dust, can become small; commands rat, owl, bat, moth, fox, wolf; directs storm, fog, thunder.
weaknesses: cannot enter uninvited the first time
power ceases at day; changes only at noon, sunrise, sunset when away from his lair
running water only at slack or flood of tide
needs native earth and cannot rest in soil barren of holy memories
creatures.quote: he is brute, and more than brute; he is devil in callous, and the heart of him is not

creatures.name: Bat at the window

creatures.quote: there came a big bat and sat on the window-sill.

vampire_lore.detail: Cannot be hurt by mere strength; a stronger body of men can hold him only at certain times.
vampire_lore.quote: This vampire which is amongst us is of himself so strong in person as twenty men

vampire_lore.rule: Necromancy and command of the dead and animals
vampire_lore.detail: Commands rat, owl, bat, moth, fox, wolf and the elements.
vampire_lore.quote: he can command all the meaner things: the rat, and the owl, and the bat—the moth, and the fox, and the wolf

vampire_lore.detail: Wolf (Whitby dog), bat (Whitby window, Lucy's window), mist round himself only, moonlight dust, can grow small to slip hairbreadth gaps.
vampire_lore.quote: He can transform himself to wolf, as we gather from the ship arrival in Whitby, when he tear open the dog

vampire_lore.detail: No small power in a half-dark world.
vampire_lore.quote: He can see in the dark—no small power this

vampire_lore.rule: Feeds on blood and grows younger
vampire_lore.detail: Does not eat other food; plentiful blood refreshes him.
Throws no shadow, no mirror image.
vampire_lore.quote: He throws no shadow; he make in the mirror no reflect

vampire_lore.rule: Must be invited in the first time
vampire_lore.detail: After that he can enter as he pleases.
vampire_lore.quote: He may not enter anywhere at the first, unless there be some one of the household who bid him to come

vampire_lore.detail: Away from his earth-home he can change only at noon, exact sunrise or sunset.
vampire_lore.quote: His power ceases, as does that of all evil things, at the coming of the day.

vampire_lore.detail: He can pass running water only at slack or flood of the tide.
vampire_lore.quote: he can only pass running water at the slack or the flood of the tide

vampire_lore.detail: Garlic afflicts him; in presence of a crucifix he stays far off and silent.
vampire_lore.quote: in their presence he take his place far off and silent with respect.

vampire_lore.rule: Wild rose, sacred bullet, stake, beheading
vampire_lore.detail: Rose confines him to coffin; sacred bullet fired into coffin kills; stake or cut-off head gives rest.
vampire_lore.quote: a sacred bullet fired into the coffin kill him so that he be true dead

vampire_lore.rule: Needs his earth/coffin-home and unhallowed ground
vampire_lore.detail: Cannot rest in soil of holy memories; graves of his good descendants sanctify the earth where he can dwell.
vampire_lore.quote: in soil barren of holy memories it cannot rest.

vampire_lore.detail: Dracula family learned secrets in the Scholomance above Lake Hermanstadt where the devil claims the tenth scholar.
vampire_lore.quote: where the devil claims the tenth scholar as his due.

vampire_lore.rule: Best time to strike: noon to sunset
vampire_lore.detail: Find him in man form between noon and sunset.
vampire_lore.quote: we may find him in his form of man between the hours of noon and sunset
